title.narrative: Global Health Supply Chain Technical Assistance - Tanzania

description.narrative: (Tanzania): &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;!--td {border: 1px solid #ccc;}br {mso-data-placement:same-cell;}--&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;With FY 2022 funds, the project will continue to provide technical assistance on Malaria health commodities by supporting the National Malaria Control Programme (NMCP) in pipeline monitoring of malaria commodities to guide in decision making such as expediting shipments. GHSC TA will also enhance data quality and visibility through investing in system integration and data quality assessments. The project will ensure monitoring of supply chain performance through MOH/PSU and PORALG structures through advocating for the importance of reporting quality data, performance feedback sharing and initiatives such as the IMPACT team's approach. Note: This activity is also receiving HIV HSS funds.....
